description: EXPLAIN returns the plan in the account's tabular shape - ten columns: step, id, parentOperators, operation, objects, alias, expressions, partitionsTotal, partitionsAssigned, bytesAssigned - with a GlobalStats row first and then one row per operator, each naming its parent. A full SELECT lays out Result / Limit / Sort / Aggregate / Filter / TableScan in that order, a join adds a Join step over one TableScan per side, a scan names its table fully qualified, and EXPLAIN USING TABULAR is the default shape spelled out. Every test skips snowflake: the operators, expressions and partition statistics are Frostlake's own - the account plans with its optimizer and its storage's real partition counts.

skip.reason: asserts Frostlake's operators and expressions (TableScan / Filter / Aggregate / ...); the account plans the same query with its own optimizer, operator names and partition statistics.
